chronicle.text: Dubos drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Neizougem scratched a mark </\|> into wood.
Kizelis tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Vuzeis gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Nethaik tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Neizougem went back to a thing they had made a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Neizougem tied a stone flake and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Vuzeis struck flint with flint and stared at what happened.
Vuzeis struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Vuzeis buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
Thibodam found that what Nethaik had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
Naiza took in the orphan Vanone, no relation, the first time a stranger raised another's child.
A thirsty year: 4 people died for want of water.
Thouvai attacked Dubos: the first violence.
Sorain struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
Touzeizok tied a blade and wood together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
Vanone tied a club and a club together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
4 people now take the mark <\o-> to go with rabbits, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Lalu came back for food left 5 weeks before, and it was still there.
A hungry year: 4 people starved.
At (35, 34) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Vanone had put in the most.
The mark <\o-> has drifted: it went with rabbits, and now, for 3 people, with water.
5 people now take the mark <-.-> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
3 people now take the mark <v\/> to go with a grave, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <\o-> has drifted: it went with water, and now, for 6 people, with rabbits.
Ravoune killed Lason in revenge for Nusai, attacked by Lason in year 23.
Revenge answered revenge: the feud between the kin of Ravoune and the kin of Lason had begun.
Douneil killed Thouvai after being attacked by Ravoune in year 24.
Revenge answered revenge: the feud between the kin of Douneil and the kin of Thouvai had begun.
12 people now take the mark <^\^> to go with a grave, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
